<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates applicable to the target molecule that involve breaking a halide (leaving group) and forming a C‑N bond, typical of an S_NAr reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
